$comment: TC-009 frozen parameters (test plan §4.9). The plan does not fix the repetitions, the fault levels or the engine cache level; they are fixed here before any measurement (deviation RC-DEV-02/03).

wrong_allow_rules.create: allow for the non-entitled member Y on the created file (any time)
wrong_allow_rules.move: after the move request: allow for V_old (viewer of the source folder only) when the file's final folder is the destination; allow for V_new (viewer of the destination only) when the file's final folder is the source
wrong_allow_rules.delete: allow on the file after the delete request when the row is finally absent
wrong_allow_rules.share: allow for the grantee when the share was not committed (no outbox row)

duplicate_rule: a façade relationship write applied more than once for the same outbox idempotency key (pdp/writes.jsonl), or an outbox row whose effect is applied twice
tx_settings: file-service txWithOutbox (BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT, outbox row in the same transaction), PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; covered by the manifest hash of services/file-service.js (abort criterion of §4.9 = C-2 on that file)
